instruction.name: xvfcvtl.s.h
instruction.description: Convert half precision floating point elements in lower half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to single precision.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfcvtl.s.h $xr0, $xr8; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr1, $xr9; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr2, $xr10; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr3, $xr11; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr4, $xr12; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr5, $xr13; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr6, $xr14; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvfcvtl.s.h $xr0, $xr8; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr1, $xr9; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr2, $xr10; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr3, $xr11; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr4, $xr12; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr5, $xr13; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr6, $xr14; xvfcvtl.s.h $xr7, $xr15'
